ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure there is a JK flip-flop block; the upper left input is labeled J and is connected to constant 1; the lower left input is labeled K and is connected to constant 0; the middle left is clock input C, with a triggering-edge symbol; the right-side outputs are Q and the inverted output Q̅. Then reason: the problem gives the initial state of the flip-flop as Q=0. When clock pulse C arrives, judging according to the JK flip-flop state table, J=1, K=0 corresponds to the set state, therefore the next state after triggering is Q_next=1. So after the clock pulse arrives, the flip-flop state is 1.
